0022600120.text: The Timberwolves (2-0, 2-0 on the road, 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West) are on a two-game winning streak, while the Cavaliers (1-1, 1-0 at home, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back, 9th in the East) are coming off a win. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out with an Achilles injury after surgery and averaged 12.2 points and 30.4 minutes per game last season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and Cleveland won their last meeting 146-134 in Cleveland on January 10, 2026.
